Q5174.reason: Ex post facto laws ease conviction by requiring less or different evidence than at the time of the act; raising the proof required is outside Calder’s categories.

Q5188.reason: A palpable pulse is the arterial pressure wave felt where an artery lies close to the skin, not a venous or atrial event.

Q5195.reason: A one-year durational residency bar to public school, adopted only to cut costs, penalizes interstate migration and violates equal protection.
